text:
No tree-cover loss event of **0.5 hectares or more** was detected on the property between 2021 and 2025.

The data did show **0.4 hectares of loss in smaller patches in 2021**. Other small or narrow changes may have been missed because the Hansen data use 30-metre pixels. The assessment does not establish whether the property is deforestation-free or meets any regulatory standard.
